name: Stylee Night Mode for Safari
subtitle: Mail, spreadsheets & search
description:
Stylee Night Mode for Safari brings a darker appearance to mail, spreadsheets, and search, with a separate setting for each supported website.

WORKS WITH THREE WEBSITES
• Gmail: dark styling for the inbox, message reading view, and compose window.
• Google Sheets: dark controls and a filtered grid.
• Google Search: dark results and suggestions.
This extension supports these websites only; it does not apply night mode to every website.

YOUR APPEARANCE, YOUR CHOICE
• On (Always dark): keep dark appearance enabled.
• Off (Website default): restore the website’s own appearance.
• System (Follow device): follow your Mac’s appearance setting.
Choose from the Safari toolbar. Each supported website remembers its own choice on this Mac. Off does not force a light theme.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Appearance changes happen locally. No browsing or message data is collected or transmitted by the extension. No analytics, advertising, tracking, or remote code. Your preferences stay on your Mac.

THOUGHTFUL COLOR HANDLING
Email foregrounds and backgrounds are adjusted together for readability. Photos and image-backed sections retain their original appearance. In spreadsheets, displayed cell colors change, while cell values and document formatting remain unchanged.

SIMPLE SETUP
Open the Mac app, enable the extension in Safari Settings, and allow access to the supported websites. Reload any pages that were already open, then choose an appearance from the toolbar.

Requires macOS 26 or later and Safari 26 or later. A Google account is required for Gmail and private spreadsheets. Website updates may occasionally require compatibility fixes.

Independent software from Stylee, Inc. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google or Apple.
reviewNotes:
This macOS app contains a Safari Web Extension and a native setup/help interface. It does not require a separate account with us and has no purchases.

To test: open the Mac app, click Open Safari Extension Settings, enable Stylee Night Mode for Safari, and allow website access. Visit https://www.google.com/search?q=safari to test without signing in. Open the Safari toolbar popup and test On, Off, and System. System follows the Mac’s appearance. Off restores the original website appearance.

Gmail and Google Sheets can be tested with a reviewer-controlled Google account. We do not provide or require access to a personal mailbox. The extension never sends emails or edits spreadsheet values. Its Sheets filter changes only displayed colors.

Requested Google account/helper hosts are used only for embedded account/app-picker frames within the supported products. Standalone Google account pages are not restyled. The native extension handler performs no remote processing. Preferences remain local; no data is collected.

Release is configured for manual release after approval.
promotionalText: A calmer look for mail, spreadsheets, and search. Choose always dark, website default, or follow your Mac. Works with Gmail, Google Sheets, and Google Search in Safari.
